# Each receipt line has a deterministic product UUIDv5 generated by the database

## Description

Table retail_receipts_import.receipt_lines stores a deterministic product identifier (UUIDv5) built from the receipt's chain_id and the line's printed_text. The database generates it on insert and update. The identifier is NOT NULL for every row, historical rows included, and external consumers can read it.

## Acceptance Criteria

Verify: every row of receipt_lines, old and new, has a non-null identifier; a consumer following the contract's description reproduces the same value from chain_id and printed_text.

## Boundaries

- The agent chooses by best practice and proposes to the owner for approval, with reasoning and the alternatives considered, before any code is written: the column name; how external consumers read the identifier; the namespace value; where in the database the namespace constant lives; the order in which the two routines are applied to printed_text; the function and separator that join the chain identifier and the printed text into one string.
- The name fed to UUIDv5 is built with the routines described in doc-inbox/sanitize-text.md and doc-inbox/unaccent-grocery-tracker.md.
- The method of building the name is documented in the contract so that users can reproduce it.
- The namespace is chosen correctly, stored in the database "constants", and stated in the contract.
